name: Escape from Precinct 27
source:
The year is 2035, it's Harry's second day at work at Roarktown Prison System, and something has gone wrong already -- a nuclear blast detonated outside his precinct and trapped him in his security booth! With the help (or the coercion) of his handler, the mysterious Ms. 27, Harry must find a way to convince a pair of mean teens to rescue him, or he will never Escape from Precinct 27.

[From [url=https://sophiefromhowls.itch.io/escape-from-precinct-27-ne]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2035年，这是哈利在罗克镇监狱系统工作的第二天，但已经出了问题——在他的管辖区外引爆了核爆炸，把他困在了保安亭里！在他的经纪人、神秘的27号女士的帮助（或胁迫）下，哈利必须想办法说服一对卑鄙的青少年来营救他，否则他将永远无法逃离27区。

[来自[url=https://sophiefromhowls.itch.io/escape-from-precinct-27-ne]itch.io[/url]]
